_note: How hard each question is, 1 (easy) to 4 (hardest). 1: a well-known list (primes, multiples of 13) or one fixed step; 2: differences that grow steadily or are squares, a plain power, or a step that alternates; 3: a power with a number added (n³ + n), two series taking turns, or a step that changes as it goes; 4: a rule inside the digits, two series with different powers, or a pair printed the wrong way round. Practice and Classroom ask the questions in this order (lib/levels.ts). Questions marked needs-review have none. tools/check_levels.ts checks them.
